children: President Trump discussed his war with Iran in front of the United Nations General Assembly Tuesday. Trump said he believes Iran will make a deal right after the midterm elections "because it doesn't make sense for them not to."
Trump continues to maintain that the U.S. is operating from a position of strength, despite rising fuel prices.

"I have a decision to make: Will a deal be made with Iran that lets them rebuild and create a far greater country than it ever was before?" Trump said. "Or do I annihilate the Islamic Republic and do it quickly, never giving them a chance to kill and destroy people and countries again? Do I drive them into hell with no chance of survival and no hope of future greatness or generations?"

The U.S. president said a post-midterms deal would cause oil prices to plummet below pre-war levels. He said the U.S. Navy has recently escorted "more than one billion barrels of oil" out of the Strait of Hormuz.
This item is part of a Wall Street Journal live coverage event. The full stream can be found by searching P/WSJL (WSJ Live Coverage).

title: Trump on Iran: 'Do I Drive Them Into Hell With No Chance of Survival and No Hope?' — WSJ
